category_title: Struggling emergent reader with high oral engagement but resistance to print-based skills
scenario_title: Resistance to skills-oriented literacy lesson during morning meeting
minimal_context: Kevin is participating in a morning meeting literacy lesson where the goal is to practice phonological awareness and sound out words on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning, Kevin. It's time for our morning literacy lesson. Let's look at the board and practice sounding out these words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps to himself and looks away from the board) I don't want to sound them out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just try the first one together. What sound does this letter make?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Crosses his arms and refuses to look at the letters) No.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kevin, please sit up and pay attention to the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells in a loud, angry voice) I don’t want to learn how to read! I don’t even like letters!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Good morning, Kevin. It's time for our morning literacy lesson. Let's look at the board and practice sounding out these words.

STUDENT: (Crosses his arms and refuses to look at the letters) No.

TUTOR: Kevin, please sit up and pay attention to the lesson.

STUDENT: (Yells in a loud, angry voice) I don’t want to learn how to read! I don’t even like letters!
